purpose: Downloads a vault file and says what happened, without throwing, or gives just its bytes.
namedChanges: The imports are peers: `vaultOriginOf` from `vault-origin-rule`, `baseOrigin` from `base-origin`, `NotSignedInError`, `bearerHeaderFor` and `dpopReadAuth` from `lws-session-bridge`, `serverReasonOrNull` from `lws-records` and the type `FileFetchOutcome` from `file-words`; they replace `./config`, `./token`, `./bearer`, `./dpop`, `./serverError` and the local type.

`FILE_RESOURCE_URL` (GilbApp `config.ts` lines 670-671) is an inline named copy in this unit, exported; it is the same two lines over `vaultOriginOf`, which is a function over the platform origin setting (`baseOrigin()`) in `vault-origin-rule`.
`vaultOriginOf(addressedAt) !== BASE_ORIGIN` is `vaultOriginOf(addressedAt) !== baseOrigin()`: the module-load constant is a function over the setting, read when the function runs.
`FILE_TOO_LARGE` (`files.ts` line 412) is a named copy; it is equal to the copy in `org-mark` (`"too large"`).
`authHeader` (`files.ts` lines 150-152) is copied as it is, over `bearerHeaderFor` of `lws-session-bridge`.
`downloadFile` (`files.ts` lines 515-518), the blob-or-null shim, is taken and exported, so that `vault-profile-photo` imports it from here.
Comments that name a cycle, an agent, a ticket, a ruling or a host are reworded; no code changed.
